name: pdf-samenvoegen
description: Merge your own PDFs in a confirmed order. Upload files to your connected account, check names and page counts, confirm the order and download one PDF. Up to five files, 5 MB each and 25 MB total. Files expire after forty minutes and are removed from active storage within one hour.
